items.text: Not much optimism DeVonta Smith plays Sunday vs Rams; sidelined with hamstring, expectation he won’t go. Rams get Puka Nacua back.
items.why: Hamstring; missed practices this week after playing through similar issue prior week.
items.implication: Eagles WR corps thinned; Nacua return boosts Rams pass game vs depleted secondary targets.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Eagles depth WRs; full Nacua role expected.

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on injured reserve due to hamstring injury; out at least four games, no surgery needed.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated in Week 3; coach confirmed IR path for recovery of at least four weeks.
items.implication: Saints backfield opens significantly for remainder of short-term schedule.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries/targets for remaining RBs; three-way committee expected.

items.text: Rams HC Sean McVay expects WR Puka Nacua (groin/hip) to play Sunday vs Eagles after limited practice and progress.
items.why: Good workout/walkthrough; short-term injury, no IR consideration, explosiveness returning.
items.implication: Rams WR1 back in favorable spot; Adams usage may normalize but overall volume rises.
items.opportunity: High snap/route share immediately upon return.

items.text: Lamar Jackson and Zay Flowers among those upgraded to full participants on Ravens Thursday injury report.
items.why: Jackson back soreness, Flowers hamstring; both progressed after limited Wednesday.
items.implication: Both locked in as starters; Flowers full workload expected after limited prior snaps.
items.opportunity: Flowers routes/targets normalize higher; Jackson dual-threat floor intact.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren (TNF vs CLE): led all RBs with 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches with Dowdle out; CLE allows big RB yards weekly. Top-10 play.
items.why: Workhorse role locked with Dowdle likely out again; strong matchup and prior usage.
items.implication: Must-start RB1/2 this week despite short week.

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% target share/104 YPG career with Penix; 43.5% share (9-194) in Penix return; NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Proven chemistry and volume spike with Penix back; soft secondary matchup.
items.opportunity: Dominant target share and yards potential.

items.text: LOVE Jeremiyah Love @ NYG: 26 touches (more than W1+W2 combined), 78% rush attempts, utilization 91 (5th); NYG allows 5.1 YPC (3rd-most).
items.why: Explosive usage jump + soft run defense and dual-threat profile.
items.opportunity: High touch and target share ceiling.

items.text: Fresh ETR ROS rankings: Kenneth Walker ranked 3 overall. Notable others include Parker Washington 22, Saquon Barkley 30.
items.why: How ETR would draft if season started today; factored injuries, roles, schedule.
items.implication: Walker elite ROS asset; Barkley relatively discounted vs ADP/perception.
items.opportunity: Walker lead-back security and efficiency support top-tier ranking.

items.text: Kyle Pitts has six targets through three games, none inside the 10, low aDOT; among worst underperformers relative to opportunity.
items.why: Chart of results vs opportunity; Penix return hasn't unlocked red-zone or volume yet.
items.implication: TE fade until target profile improves; low floor continues.
items.conflict: Some may still start on name/prior pedigree despite data.

items.text: Pat Thorman Week 4 rankings and snaps/pace live: DAL@HOU up in pace; LAC@SEA slow; full usage notes available.
items.why: Pace and snap projections drive start/sit and DFS; updated for Week 4 environments.
items.implication: Prioritize high-pace games for volume; avoid slogs.

items.text: LOVE Trevor Lawrence @ CIN: 19+ FP in 8 of last 9; highest Week 4 O/U (51.5); torched CIN last year (271/3).
items.why: Hot streak + smash game script/environment and historical matchup success.
items.implication: QB1 upside play in high-total spot.
items.opportunity: Pass volume and TD equity elevated.

items.text: HATE Justin Herbert @ SEA: 44% pressure rate this year; SEA 4th in pressure, league-low 5.0 YPA allowed; Chargers bottom-3 implied total.
items.why: Tough defensive matchup amplifying existing pressure issues; low game total.

items.text: HATE Kyle Pitts @ NO: 16% target share/34 YPG career with Penix; under 8 FP in 9 of 13 such games; TE37 utilization this year.
items.why: Persistent low volume and inefficiency even with preferred QB; data-backed underperformance.

items.text: LOVE Garrett Wilson @ CHI: 36% target share last time Mitchell out (likely again); 78% catch rate, 9.0 YPT; CHI allows 14+ YPR.
items.why: Clear WR1 volume bump without competition + soft secondary.
